common.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select it manually

gate.title: Verify the setup token
gate.intro: There is no administrator yet, so this wizard is open to anyone who can reach this page. Enter the setup token to prove you can access this server's terminal.
gate.hint: The token is shown once in the terminal that ran lingedge install server. If it is lost, root can run lingedge config setup-token --reset to generate a new one.
gate.label: Setup token
gate.memoryOnly: The token is kept only in this page's memory. It is never written to the address bar, cookies or browser storage, so you must enter it again after a refresh.
gate.urlTokenIgnored: A token parameter in the address bar was ignored and removed: the token must never appear in a URL. Enter it below.
gate.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.

installed.title: Installation is complete and the wizard is closed
installed.body: This server has already been initialized and every wizard endpoint now returns 410 permanently. Sign in to the admin console instead. The wizard cannot be reopened; see the operations documentation if you really need to reinitialize.

env.title: Environment check
env.description: Checks the server version, system time, data directory, master key and how the wizard is listening. You cannot continue while a blocking item exists.
env.blocking: There are blocking items. Fix them as described and check again.
env.passedWithWarnings: The environment check passed, but there are warnings to review.
env.emptyBody: The server returned no results. Run the checks again.

master_key.readable: Master key is readable (contents never shown)

db.title: MySQL
db.description: Configure and test MySQL (8.0.16 or later, not MariaDB). The target database must be empty; the wizard never overwrites existing data.
db.resumeHint: This step was completed earlier. If the server has restarted since, the migrate account password is no longer in memory and must be submitted again here (it is never written to disk, ADR-026).

mode.label: Account mode
mode.create: Create the database and accounts with a temporary administrator (recommended)
mode.createHint: The administrator credentials are used once in memory and zeroed right after the database and the three dedicated accounts are created. They are never written to disk.
mode.existing: Use a pre-created database and accounts
mode.existingHint: You must already have created an empty database and the three dedicated accounts, and you must provide the migrate account password.

field.socketHint: Absolute path of the MySQL socket file. TLS is not needed over a socket.
field.migratePwCreateHint: Leave empty to let the server generate one, shown once on the last step.
field.migratePwExistingHint: Required: kept in memory only, used to initialize the database, never written to disk.
field.maintPwHint: Optional; in create mode the server generates one when empty.
field.fixedAccounts: The dedicated account names are fixed by the migrations:
field.pwCreateHint: Leave empty to generate a random password (stored only encrypted in the runtime credentials file, nothing to remember); at least 12 characters if you set one.
field.pwExistingHint: The password of the pre-created lingedge_app account.

db.resultEmpty: Nothing submitted yet: fill in the form above and choose Test connection and save.
db.ok: MySQL checks passed and the credentials were encrypted into the runtime credentials file.

err.portRange: The port must be between 1 and 65535
err.socketAbsolute: The socket path must be absolute
err.databaseName: Use only letters, digits, underscores and dollar signs, up to 64 characters

db.tlsRequired: A non-loopback host requires TLS; tick Connect with TLS

redis.title: Redis
redis.description: Configure and test Redis (major version 8 or later). The wizard never runs FLUSHDB and never clears existing keys.

field.pwHint: Leave empty if there is none.

redis.resultEmpty: Nothing submitted yet: fill in the form above and choose Test connection and save.
redis.ok: Redis checks passed and the credentials were encrypted into the runtime credentials file.

err.addressFormat: The address must look like host:port
err.dbRange: The database number must be between 0 and 15

init.title: Initialize database
init.description: Runs every migration in-process and writes the seed data. A brand-new empty database has nothing to lose, so irreversible migrations need no extra confirmation.
init.running: Running migrations. Do not close this page…
init.upToDateTitle: The database is already up to date
init.alreadyDone: The database was initialized earlier; there is no new migration list this time.
init.recovered: The connection dropped during migration, but the server finished initializing (confirmed by a status query).
init.needDbStep: Go back to the MySQL step and submit again

admin.title: Create administrator
admin.description: This is the only initial administrator of the platform. Only you set the password; it never appears in any file or log, and there is no default password.
admin.doneBefore: This step was completed earlier; the administrator already exists.

rule.title: Password rules
rule.classes: At least three character classes (upper case, lower case, digits, symbols); passphrases of 20 characters or more need only two
rule.noEmail: Does not contain the local part of the email
rule.server: The server also rejects common weak password patterns and is the final judge.

err.name: Enter a display name
err.weak: The password does not meet the rules; check the list below
err.mismatch: The two passwords do not match

totp.title: Bind an authenticator
totp.intro: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key manually, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows. The key is shown only this once.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.warning: The recovery codes are shown only this once and only their hashes are stored. Save them to a password manager or offline right now; they are the only way back in if you lose the authenticator.
recovery.ack: I have saved the recovery codes safely

system.title: Basic settings
system.description: Site name, public access URL, run mode, time zone and default language. You can change them later in system settings.

field.runModeHint: Commercial mode enables plans and billing features (P5); you can change it later in system settings.
field.baseUrlHint: The public address of the admin console, including the scheme, for example https plus your domain.
field.timezoneHint: An IANA time zone name. Storage and the API always use UTC.

err.baseUrl: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://
err.timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone name

keys.title: Key initialization
keys.description: Generates the internal identity and signing keys: the private node CA, the config signing key and the Server gRPC certificate, all stored encrypted with master.key.
keys.ok: The internal identity and signing keys are initialized.

masterKey.title: Important: keep master.key apart from database backups
masterKey.body: master.key is the master key that encrypts every secret (passwords, private keys, tokens). Keeping it next to a database backup is like leaving the key in the lock, and if you lose it every ciphertext in the database becomes permanently unreadable. Back up master.key to a different medium or location right now.
masterKey.ack: I understand that master.key must be kept apart from database backups, and I have arranged a separate backup

complete.title: Finish installation
complete.description: Review the reminders below, then finish. This writes install.lock, closes the wizard permanently and invalidates the setup token immediately.
complete.doneBody: install.lock was written, the setup wizard is closed and the setup token is invalid.
complete.adminUrlMissing: The access URL you entered earlier is no longer on this page. Enter the access URL you set in the basic settings:
complete.adminLogin: Sign in with the administrator email and password you just created.

migrate.title: Migrate account password (shown only once)
migrate.body: The migrate password was generated by the server and is not stored. Copy it now and run the command below as root on the server to save it; if you miss it, you can reset it later with credential reset.
migrate.command: Command that saves the migrate credentials
migrate.ack: I have saved the migrate password

next.title: Suggested next steps
next.tempAdmin: Delete the temporary database administrator account used to create the database (if any).
next.credential: Save the migrate credentials as root on the server; upgrades need them.
next.backup: Back up master.key separately and keep it apart from database backups.
next.node: Register the first node, then create the first site.

setup.token_invalid: The setup token is missing or wrong. Check the token shown in the terminal; repeated failures are rate limited.
setup.already_installed: Installation is complete and the wizard is permanently closed.
setup.insecure_transport: This endpoint carries credentials and needs a secure transport: use an SSH tunnel to the loopback address, or go through a TLS reverse proxy.
setup.database_not_empty: The target database is not empty. Choose an empty database or clean it first; the wizard never overwrites existing data.
setup.precheck_failed: A precheck failed: follow the detailed reasons below and try again.
setup.mode_active: The server is still in setup mode.

auth.pw_policy: The password does not meet the strength rules; check the password rules list.

validation.failed: The submitted content failed validation; check the marked fields.

resource.conflict: This action is not allowed in the current state, or an earlier step is not complete. Follow the reasons below.

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many requests. Try again later.

internal.error: Internal server error. Use the Request ID to find it in the server log.

client.network_error: No response from the server: check that the service is still running and that the network or SSH tunnel is still up.
client.bad_response: The server returned a response that could not be understood.

setup.token_invalid: The setup token is missing or wrong.
setup.already_installed: The system is already installed; the setup wizard is closed.
setup.insecure_transport: This endpoint carries credentials and requires a secure transport (TLS).
setup.database_not_empty: The target database is not empty.
setup.mode_active: The server is in setup mode: complete the setup wizard first.

auth.pw_policy: The password does not meet the strength policy.
auth.unauthenticated: Not authenticated, or the token is no longer valid.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

resource.conflict: This action is not allowed in the current state.
resource.not_found: The requested resource does not exist.

client.network_error: No response was received from the server.
client.bad_response: The server returned a response that could not be understood.

check.system_time_bad: The system time looks wrong ({time}): certificates and sessions depend on a correct clock. Fix the time first.
check.data_dir_bad: The data directory is not writable ({path}): make sure it exists and is owned by the service user.
check.master_key_bad: The master key is not readable: install step 18 should have generated /etc/lingedge/server/master.key and provided it through systemd LoadCredential (contents are never shown).
check.master_key_ok: The master key is readable (contents never shown)
check.migrations_bad: The embedded migration set is invalid (a build defect).
check.server_env_bad: server.env is not configured: it must be set before normal operation (Redis key space le:<env>:...).
check.listen_loopback: The wizard listens on the loopback address {addr} only (use an SSH tunnel for remote access).
check.listen_exposed: The wizard listens on the non-loopback address {addr}: endpoints that carry credentials must use TLS (directly or through a trusted reverse proxy that sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https), otherwise they return 400 setup.insecure_transport.
check.token_bad: The setup token hash file does not exist ({path}): every write endpoint of the web wizard will return 401 (Tools generates it); the headless setup --from-file path does not need it.

step.database_ok: The MySQL precheck passed; the {accounts} passwords were encrypted into the runtime credentials file (the migrate password stays in memory only).
step.database_setuserid: The administrator cannot grant global SET_USER_ID; the trigger probe decides whether it is needed.
step.database_nomaint: No maint account is configured: partition maintenance jobs will be skipped explicitly with a warning.
step.redis_ok: Redis {version} passed the check (major version 8 or later); the credentials were encrypted into the runtime credentials file.
step.init_uptodate: The database is already at the latest version {version} (no pending migrations).
step.system_ok: The basic system settings were saved (run mode {mode}).
step.keys_ok: Internal identities and keys are initialized (private CA, config signing key, Server gRPC leaf certificate, deploy.lineage); CA fingerprint {fp}. Keep the master key master.key separate from database backups (losing it makes every private key undecryptable, F-7).
step.complete_lock_failed: Warning: writing install.lock failed. Check the data directory permissions; the Server rewrites it from the database record on restart.
step.complete_token_delete_failed: Warning: deleting the setup token hash file failed. Delete {path} by hand.
step.complete_token_cleared: The directory of the setup token hash file is not writable, so its contents were emptied to invalidate the token permanently. Delete {path} by hand.
step.complete_closed: The wizard endpoints now return 410 permanently; sign in to Admin with the administrator you just created.
step.complete_migrate_generated: The migrate account password was generated by the wizard and is shown only once in this response; it is not stored. Save it now on the root side with sudo lingedge-server migrate credential init (host, port and database are pre-filled; you only type the password). If you cannot save it in time, reset it later with migrate credential reset --admin-user <admin>. Delete the temporary database administrator account yourself.
step.complete_migrate_manual: Before upgrading, save the migrate account password on the root side with sudo lingedge-server migrate credential init (or use credential reset later). Delete the temporary database administrator account yourself.

reason.max128: At most 128 bytes, without NUL or line breaks.
reason.max512: At most 512 bytes, without NUL or line breaks.
reason.socketExclusive: Mutually exclusive with host/port: set either host and port, or a socket.
reason.socketPath: Must be a normalized absolute path (at most 100 bytes, no NUL or line breaks).
reason.host: Must be a host name or IP (or use a Unix socket instead).
reason.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
reason.dbName: Must be a MySQL identifier (letters, digits, _, {'$'}; at most 64 characters).
reason.fixedAccount: Must be {name} (the migrations grant table privileges to this fixed account name).
reason.userName: Must be 1-32 characters of letters, digits, _, . or -.
reason.migrateUserDiffers: Must differ from the app and maint accounts.
reason.tlsSocket: Must be off for a Unix socket connection (it does not cross the network).
reason.tlsRemote: Must be on for a non-loopback database host (credentials and data must not cross the network in clear text).
reason.createDbName: The wizard only creates dedicated databases named lingedge or lingedge_* (it never touches other databases); for an existing empty database, turn off automatic creation.
reason.adminUserRequired: Required when automatic creation is on.
reason.totpFlag: Two-factor authentication must be enabled when a code is provided.
reason.baseUrlInvalid: The stored base URL is not a valid URL with a host name or IP; submit the basic settings again.
reason.baseUrlMissing: Submit the basic settings with the base URL first: the gRPC leaf certificate SAN is derived from it.
reason.migrateGone: The wizard process restarted after the database step, so the migrate account password is no longer in memory: submit the database step again (with the migrate password, or with the temporary administrator credentials to reset the migrate account).
reason.dbNotEmpty: Database "{name}" already contains {count} table(s); the wizard never overwrites an existing database (FR-6). Use an empty dedicated database.
reason.insecureTransport: Use an SSH tunnel to the loopback listener, or terminate TLS (directly, or at a trusted reverse proxy that sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https).
reason.masterKey: The master key is unavailable: without the KEK, passwords and private keys cannot be encrypted. Make sure /etc/lingedge/server/master.key was generated by Tools and is readable.
reason.email: Must be a valid email address (at most 255 characters).
reason.pwEmailLocal: Must not contain the local part of the email address.
reason.pwEmail: Must not be the email address.
reason.pwSameAsCurrent: Must differ from the current password.
reason.pwWeak: Must not contain a common weak password pattern.
reason.pwFewUnique: Must contain at least 5 distinct characters.
reason.pwTwoClasses: Must contain at least two character classes.
reason.pwThreeClasses: Must contain at least three of: lowercase, uppercase, digit, symbol.
